motion.name: state

motion.name: chevron

motion.name: caption-step
motion.purpose: The place name stepping up on a pointed-at photograph, and a tab panel fading up 12px.

motion.name: strip-lead
motion.purpose: A photograph taking or giving up the lead width (flex-grow 1 to 1.64).

motion.name: slice-rise
motion.purpose: The one authored entrance: each strip slice is revealed from the bottom on load.

motion.name: photo-settle
motion.purpose: Each photograph settles from 1.18 scale while its slice rises.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion every animation and transition is cut to nothing; all content is visible without it.

narrative.overview:
Every page opens on photographs of places and then gets out of the way. A full-width strip of famous destinations sits directly under a white navigation band; below it, on a flat oyster-grey ground, charcoal type states the errand plainly and lists every service on hairline rules. The register is that of a premium travel company: luxury through restraint, corporate and trustworthy, with nothing themed and nothing decorative.

Everything that is not a photograph is type, a hairline or a burgundy mark. There are no cards, no icons other than one chevron, and no shadows on content. Sections alternate between oyster grey and white, and one burgundy band per page holds the enquiry form: the place to act. Density is generous, with wide gutters, tall section padding and columns that split five to seven.

The system rejects the single skyline hero over a row of icon cards, aircraft imagery of any kind, and themed concepts. Motion is one authored entrance on load (the photographs rise into the strip) plus short state transitions; nothing animates on scroll. English and Arabic are equal editions: every layout mirrors, and Arabic has its own faces and line heights.
keyCharacteristics: Destination photographs lead; they are full-bleed, square-cornered and separated by thin white gaps.
A flat oyster-grey ground alternating with white bands, and exactly one burgundy band per page.
One type family in two cuts (Wix Madefor Display and Text), sentence case throughout, no uppercase labels.
Hairline rules instead of boxes: lists, tabs, questions and facts are all rows on 1px lines.
Two shapes only: square corners and full pills.
One icon: a 9 by 16 chevron that mirrors in right-to-left.
Light theme only; no dark mode is defined.

rules.name: The Burgundy Rule
rules.body: Burgundy marks the brand and the next action: wordmark, pills, chevrons, step numerals, checklist strokes, the selected or hovered state, the focus ring. It never colours a heading, a paragraph, a border or a decorative shape.

rules.name: The One Band Rule
rules.body: One burgundy field per page, and it is always the enquiry band. No second drenched section, no burgundy footer, no burgundy navigation.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Sections sit on oyster grey or on white, alternating. There are no tints, gradients or textures behind text. The only gradient in the system is the dark floor under a place name on a photograph.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Nothing is set in uppercase and nothing is letter-spaced for effect. Labels are small and medium-weight, not shouted. The only tracking in the system is the slight tightening of the headline and the wordmark.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: Display type uses 700 for headlines, section titles and numerals; 600 for titles, pills and the wordmark; 500 for labels, links and captions. Body text is 400. No italics, no light weights.

rules.name: The Arabic Edition Rule
rules.body: Arabic text asks for Alexandria and Noto Sans Arabic first, never takes letter-spacing (tracking breaks the joins), and gets more room: body line-height 1.9, display line-height 1.4, caption line-height 1.5. Phone numbers stay left-to-right inside Arabic text.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed Rule
rules.body: A row of photographs always spans the whole viewport width, from edge to edge, directly under the navigation band or between two sections. A single photograph inside a section sits in a column instead and keeps its square corners.

rules.name: The Uneven Split Rule
rules.body: Two columns are never equal halves. Use five to seven or seven to five with an 8% gap.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No shadow on photographs, rows, pills, bands or text. If something needs to stand apart, change the ground or draw a hairline.

dos: Do open a page with photographs running edge to edge under the white band, or with the burgundy band when the page is about getting in touch.
Do keep photographs square-cornered, cropped to cover, and separated by 8px white gaps.
Do put a white place name at the bottom corner of a photograph, over the dark floor, whenever the photograph is named.
Do build lists as rows on 1px hairlines, with a hairline above each row and one closing the last.
Do alternate oyster grey and white between sections and end the page on the burgundy enquiry band.
Do split two columns five to seven or seven to five with an 8% gap.
Do use one burgundy pill per view and an underlined text link for the second action.
Do write layout with logical properties, mirror chevrons, and check every new surface in Arabic.
Do keep transitions on the expo ease (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)): 200ms for colour, 300ms for chevrons, 500 to 700ms for the strip.
Do honour reduced motion; everything is visible without animation.
donts: Don't add icons. The chevron is the only one, and the checklist stroke is the only other mark.
Don't build cards: no boxed, filled or four-sided-bordered containers around content.
